scenarios.name: Keep the active document tab visible with middle truncation at narrow window widths

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the user narrows the main application window so the tab strip cannot fit all tab labels at full width
the active document tab remains visible in the tab strip using middle truncation
tab overflow navigation controls remain reachable alongside the Documents button
